executive_summary: PostHog positions itself as the open‑source backbone for self‑driving product platforms, blending analytics, feature flags and experimentation in a single stack. It competes directly with established product‑analytics vendors while leveraging a free‑tier and developer‑first ethos to gain market share. Recent hiring pushes and pricing refinements signal an aggressive push to capture mid‑market and enterprise segments.
